en: The image is a black-and-white photograph depicting a festive or ceremonial street parade, likely from the early 20th century. A group of young girls in matching dresses and bonnets walks in front of a flower-adorned float, accompanied by other similarly dressed children and adults. The street is tree-lined, with large brick houses displaying flags, possibly national flags. Several people are observing from the sidewalks and from the balconies. The situation appears formal and celebratory.
